items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Then he went with this man, or I forgot, Sam Wooden.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was Tommy and King. See, Lewis left us to go with Fletcher Hennessy in 24. Tommy took his place. Then he went with this man, or I forgot, Sam Wooden. And then after he left, then Bob Shaffler came with me. And he stayed with the man until I left.
Did you work with Louis at the same time with King Arthur? Yes. You were there. Yes, yes. I was in band with Louis. That's it. Did you make many tours? Yes, we toured in Pennsylvania.

items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I had Frankie Newton. I had Nicholas Red Nichols.

ctx.x: So, what did you do when you came back?

Well, I started organizing a band. After awhile I organized a band and I had in the band such men as Big Catlett Sid Catley. I had Frankie Newton. I had Nicholas Red Nichols. And then the first band, Bushell Butch Elber was with me and Cedric, they came
back with me. And then was, I don't know, not Johnny Mitchell, he stayed over there. I had Bernard on the guitar, and I had --
